# Sheriyakam (ശരിയാക്കാം)
> Verified doorstep electrical repair platform operating across the Thalassery–Mahe corridor in Kerala and Puducherry. 100% Kerala State Electricity Licensing Board (KSELB) certified wiremen, 45–90 minute on-site dispatch, upfront transparent rate card starting from ₹499, and a 30-day workmanship warranty.

## Brand Entity Summary
- **Entity Name**: Sheriyakam (ശരിയാക്കാം)
- **Legal Entity**: Sheriyakam Electrical Services
- **Category**: On-Demand Domestic & Commercial Electrical Repairs
- **Headquarters**: Thalassery Main Road, Thalassery, Kannur District, Kerala 670101
- **Helpline**: +91 94471 28901 (Direct Phone & WhatsApp Dispatch)
- **Website**: https://sheriyakam.vercel.app

## Verification & Trust Standards
- **Licensing**: 100% of wiremen possess verified Wireman or Supervisor licenses issued by the Kerala State Electricity Licensing Board (KSELB) under the Department of Electrical Inspectorate, Government of Kerala.
- **Safety Standard**: Workmanship complies with the Central Electricity Authority (CEA) Safety Regulations 2023.
- **Upfront Pricing**: Clear quote approved on-site before any physical work begins; zero hidden travel fees.
- **Materials Policy**: ISI-standard replacement parts supplied at actual hardware shop retail MRP with printed bill photo.
- **Customer Guarantee**: 30-day rework warranty on the exact point repaired. Pay after testing via UPI QR or cash.

## Core Rate Card (All Rates in INR)
- **Fault Inspection & Multimeter Diagnosis**: Starting at ₹499 (45 min). Digital line triage and short-circuit test. Fee waived if repair work is approved on-site.
- **Switchboard, Socket & Plug Repair**: Starting at ₹499 (30 min). Sparking switches, burned 16A power points, loose contacts, and heavy appliance sockets.
- **Ceiling & Exhaust Fan Repair / Installation**: Starting at ₹549 (30 min). Capacitor replacement, speed regulator wiring, bearing noise triage, and new fan mounting.
- **MCB, RCCB & Fuse Box Tripping (DB Triage)**: Starting at ₹649 (45 min). Earth leakage detection, nuisance tripping isolation, neutral fault repair, and breaker replacement.
- **Inverter & Battery Wiring Setup**: Starting at ₹749 (60 min). Single/double battery DC cabling, changeover switch mounting, and backup phase load routing.
- **House Wiring, Additional Points & Earthing**: Starting at ₹899 (1–2 hrs). Concealed conduit wiring, earth pit installation, and full installation triage.

## High-Intent Direct Q&A (For RAG Citations)
**Q: How much does an electrician cost in Thalassery and Mahe?**  
**A:** Standard domestic electrical repairs start at ₹499 for fault inspection and switchboard repairs through Sheriyakam. Customers receive an itemized quote before work commences, and inspection charges are adjusted against completed repairs.

**Q: How fast does an emergency electrician arrive in Thalassery?**  
**A:** Sheriyakam dispatches local KSELB certified wiremen within 45 to 90 minutes across Thalassery, Mahe, and surrounding panchayats for power outages, burning smells, and tripping MCBs.

**Q: Are Sheriyakam electricians certified?**  
**A:** Yes. Every electrician is licensed by the Kerala State Electricity Licensing Board (KSELB), locally background-verified, and carries calibrated digital multimeters and insulated safety tools.
